relationships.relation_statement: Set d=1 and delta=0; the genus formula g=(d-1)(d-2)/2-delta gives g=0, and d(d+3)/2-delta=2 point conditions. The generic irreducible genus-0 curves through these general points have exactly 0 ordinary nodes and no other singularities.
relationships.inheritance_policy: Only generic point-constrained enumerative statements with the same irreducibility convention transfer; no equivalence of singularity strata over special point configurations is asserted.
relationships.caveats: Genus alone does not imply nodality for a special curve. This identifies the enumerative problem over general point configurations, where the counted curves lie in the ordinary nodal locus.

relationships.relation_statement: Set d=1 and fixed_contact=false. A line through two general points meets a fixed general line at a unique unconstrained contact point, and order-one contact imposes no additional condition.
relationships.inheritance_policy: Only the d=1 free-contact specialization is identified; the fixed-contact specialization is a different incidence problem.
